corrections.decision: Severity level must be derived strictly from the four boolean factors, never assessed independently.
corrections.rule: critical = (affects_db OR causes_error_state) AND NOT has_workaround; high = any factor true AND NOT has_workaround; medium = any factor true AND has_workaround; low = no factors true.
corrections.trigger: Issue #2 was assessed as severity:high with all four factors false, which is a contradiction.

corrections.decision: Only two labels: needs-human-review (default) and needs-copilot (auto-eligible). No ai-priority, ai-category, ai-complexity, ai-confidence, or ai-risk labels.
corrections.rule: Apply needs-human-review to all issues by default. Swap to needs-copilot only when all auto-eligibility criteria are met.
corrections.trigger: Five labels per issue made filtering impractical for the team.

corrections.decision: Copilot coding agent cannot be assigned programmatically via any GitHub API surface (REST, GraphQL, gh CLI) regardless of token type.
corrections.rule: needs-copilot label is the queue signal. A human assigns Copilot from the issue sidebar to trigger the agent.
corrections.trigger: All programmatic assignment attempts failed: GITHUB_TOKEN silently dropped, user PAT silently dropped, gh CLI returned 'Bot does not have access to the repository (replaceActorsForAssignable)'.

corrections.decision: steps_to_reproduce must be not_applicable for documentation issues, feature requests, and platform/display bugs (e.g. Charmhub metadata issues) where local reproduction is irrelevant to the fix.
corrections.rule: Only use present or missing for issues where a developer would need to reproduce the problem locally to investigate or fix it.
corrections.trigger: Unnecessary reproduction step requests on non-reproducible issue types.

corrections.decision: AI analysis comment must not include: emojis, em dashes, category field, priority field, Applied Repository Rules section, or Recommended Assignee section.
corrections.rule: Comment sections: summary, key fields (complexity/confidence/effort/auto-resolve/repro), severity breakdown, matching patterns, affected areas.
corrections.trigger: Comment was too noisy for practical use; recommended assignee suggested non-existent teams.

patterns_learned.severity_derivation: Always derive severity.level from the boolean factors. If all factors are false, level must be low regardless of issue description.
patterns_learned.steps_to_reproduce_not_applicable: Charmhub display bugs, metadata issues, documentation gaps, and feature requests do not need reproduction steps.
patterns_learned.pulse_calibration: 0.25 = a few hours; 0.5 = ~1 week; 1 = full sprint (2 weeks); 2+ = multi-sprint. Linting/tooling migrations are typically 0.25-0.5. Relation handler bugs are typically 0.5-1. New relation types are typically 1-2.
patterns_learned.auto_resolve_scope: Only documentation typos, comment-only changes, linting fixes, and patch version bumps are safe for auto-resolution. Never src/charm.py, src/state.py, src/relations/, metadata.yaml, or templates/.
